title: The Midnight Library
author: Matt Haig
description: Between life and death there is a library, and within that library, the shelves go on forever. Every book provides a chance to try another life you could have lived.

title: Clean Code
author: Robert C. Martin
description: A handbook of agile software craftsmanship that teaches how to write readable, maintainable, and efficient code.

title: A Brief History of Time
author: Stephen Hawking
description: A landmark volume exploring profound questions about the universe, time, and black holes in accessible language.

title: The Alchemist
author: Paulo Coelho
description: A shepherd boy travels from Spain to Egypt in search of a treasure, discovering the importance of listening to one's heart.

title: Introduction to Algorithms
author: Thomas H. Cormen
description: A comprehensive textbook covering a broad range of algorithms in depth, widely used in computer science courses.

title: Cosmos
author: Carl Sagan
description: A journey through the universe exploring its origin, evolution, and humanity's place within it.

title: To Kill a Mockingbird
author: Harper Lee
description: A gripping tale of racial injustice and childhood innocence in the American South, told through a young girl's eyes.

title: You Don't Know JS
author: Kyle Simpson
description: A deep dive into the core mechanisms of the JavaScript language, aimed at developers wanting true mastery.

title: The Selfish Gene
author: Richard Dawkins
description: A groundbreaking work presenting evolution from the perspective of the gene, reshaping how we understand biology.

author: George Orwell
description: A dystopian novel depicting a totalitarian regime that controls truth, thought, and history itself.

title: Design Patterns
author: Erich Gamma
description: The classic reference on reusable object-oriented software design, introducing 23 foundational design patterns.

title: The Origin of Species
author: Charles Darwin
description: The foundational text of evolutionary biology, introducing the theory of natural selection to the world.
